And from thence pa{{ls}}{{ls}}ing through Syria and Cilicia, they teach the Chri{{ls}}tians to ob{{ls}}erue the decrees of the Apo{{ls}}tles and Auncients. ''Act. 15.''

| style='vertical-align: top;' | Doing the {{ls}}ame in the cities of Lycaonia and others adioining, by a vi{{ls}}ion he is vvarned to pa{{ls}}{{ls}}e ouer the {{ls}}ea, and {{ls}}o commeth into Macedonia, vvhere he planteth the Go{{ls}}pel. ''Act. 16.''

| style='vertical-align: top;' | Hence forvvard S. Luke pur{{ls}}ueth S. Pauls {{ls}}torie, chapter by chapter, vntil his apprehen{{ls}}ion in Hieru{{ls}}alem, and arriual at Rome, in this order.

| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He returneth from Macedonia by The{{ls}}salonica to Athens, vvhere he conuerteth many, namely S. Denys Areopagita. ''Act. 17.''

| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | From Athens he commeth to Corinth, vvhere he remaineth 18 moneths. ''Act. 18.'' and hauing vi{{ls}}ited the Churches of A{{ls}}ia ''(Act. 19)'' he commeth backe to Corinth ''Act. 20.'' Vvhence he vvriteth his epi{{ls}}tle to the Romanes. ''Ro. 15.''
|-

| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | From Corinth he {{ls}}aileth to Troas in A{{ls}}ia, vvhere vpon a Sunday he rai{{ls}}ed Eutychus from death, preaching til midnight. from Troas he commeth to Miletum by {{ls}}ea, and there {{ls}}endeth for the Bi{{ls}}hops and Auncients of Ephe{{ls}}us, and exhorteth them. ''Act. 20.''
|-

| style='vertical-align: top;' | Thence comming to Hieru{{ls}}alem he is taken, ''Act. 21:'' and from the Tribune Ly{{ls}}ias deliuered to Felix the Gouernour, ''Act. 23:'' and by him left to Fe{{ls}}tus, ''Act. 24.'' he appealeth to Cae{{ls}}ar, ''Act. 25:'' and {{ls}}o is {{sc|{{ls}}ent to Rome}}, ''Act. 27:'' vvhere he arriueth. ''Act. 28.''
